name: 7kWh solar battery control and monitoring system

mentions.name: 7kWh solar battery control and monitoring system
mentions.description: A weatherproof 7kWh battery, originally built for a Burning Man project, being rebuilt with a control hub that reads data from the batteries and solar controller, remote and on-device UIs to control all the hardware from one place, and a LoRa transceiver for monitoring battery and solar status from a distance.
mentions.problem: There is a lot of DIY solar and battery hardware that needs to sync and coordinate, but no great software solution exists for this.
mentions.audience: Lots of DIY solar and battery hardware users who need their gear to sync and coordinate
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m re-habbing a weatherproof 7kWh battery I built for a Burning Man project last year.

I’m adding:

- A control hub that reads data from the batteries and the solar controller

- Remote and on-device UIs that allow a user to control all the hardware from one place

- A LoRa transceiver that allows monitoring the battery and solar status from a distance
